title: Emerging diseases of Cannabis sativa and sustainable management
scope: Emerging Cannabis sativa and hemp diseases, inoculum sources, field carryover, Neofusicoccum-associated disease, Sclerotinia white mold, southern blight, pathogen spread, and integrated disease-management context.

title: Host status and susceptibility of Cannabis sativa cultivars to root-knot nematodes
scope: Greenhouse trials evaluating Cannabis sativa hemp cultivars as hosts for multiple Meloidogyne root-knot nematode species, including galling, reproduction, cultivar response, and growth effects under infested conditions.

title: Septoria cannabicola, a new species on Cannabis sativa from Japan
scope: Morphological and molecular evidence for Septoria leaf spot disease on Cannabis sativa and the importance of organism-level identification rather than diagnosis from lesion appearance alone.

title: Draft genome sequences for four isolates of the hemp (Cannabis sativa) fungal pathogen Neofusicoccum parvum
scope: Cannabis sativa isolates of Neofusicoccum parvum collected from diseased hemp and previously shown to be pathogenic, with disease context including terminal dieback.

title: IPM Scouting and Decision Making
scope: Greenhouse IPM scouting, incoming-plant inspection, sticky-card monitoring, fungus gnat and shore-fly differentiation context, hotspot mapping, recordkeeping, and treatment-effectiveness review.
